as org str ksoft
as loud str KSoft

# A schema that refers to nothing
validate_file @org schemas/plain.json
as three obj n 0.:int=3
validate_file @three schemas/plain.json

# A schema that refers to other files, one of them through another
as good obj org $org count 0.:int=3 unit 0.:str="kg"
validate_file @good schemas/root.json
as bad obj org $loud count 0.:int=12 unit 0.:str="mile"
validate_file @bad schemas/root.json

# A reference to a file that does not exist, and to one that is not JSON
as planned set @good .plan 0.:int=1
validate_file @planned schemas/root.json
as noted set @good .note 0.:int=1
validate_file @noted schemas/root.json

# What it refuses
validate_file @good schemas/missing.json
validate_file @good schemas/broken.json
